title: Computational prediction of flavonoid inhibitors targeting the infectious bronchitis virus spike protein through integrated virtual screening and molecular dynamics.
authors: Gul, Irfan; Bashir, Sadaf; Aman, Muttahir; Hassan, Amreena; Rather, Muzamil Ahmad; Sofi, Ubaid; Chikan, Naveed Anjum; Shabir, Nadeem
one_liner_zh: 该文使用虚拟筛选和分子动力学模拟预测靶向IBV刺突蛋白的黄酮类抑制剂，属于蛋白质-小分子对接与MD模拟的常规应用，方法创新性一般，但问题和方法与蛋白质结构计算相关。
abstract: Infectious bronchitis virus (IBV) remains a major threat to the poultry industry owing to its high transmissibility and the continuous emergence of antigenically diverse variants that compromise vaccine efficacy. The viral spike protein, which mediates host cell attachment and membrane fusion, represents an attractive target for antiviral intervention. In this study, a structure-based computational approach was employed to identify phytochemical inhibitors targeting the IBV spike protein. A curated library (PCLibVer2) comprising 2,400 phytochemicals derived from poultry-safe botanicals was subjected to hierarchical virtual screening using Glide against two receptor-binding domain-associated binding pockets. The three top-ranked lead phytochemicals were evaluated by three independent 100 ns molecular dynamics simulations, followed by trajectory-based Prime MM-GBSA binding free energy calculations and principal component analysis. All three phytochemicals exhibited favourable docking scores and stable protein-ligand interactions throughout the simulations. Molecular dynamics analyses demonstrated stable structural behaviour, persistent hydrogen-bond interactions, and reduced conformational sampling relative to the apo protein. MM-GBSA analysis predicted favourable binding free energies for all complexes, with Rutin exhibiting the strongest binding affinity at both binding pockets (- 50.07 +/- 13.14 and - 55.14 +/- 20.22 kcal/mol). Principal component analysis further showed that Rutin consistently produced the most compact conformational ensemble, indicating reduced protein flexibility. In silico ADMET analysis identified comparable pharmacokinetic profiles for the three lead phytochemicals. Collectively, these findings highlight the potential of flavonoid-based phytochemicals as natural inhibitors of IBV spike-mediated viral entry. This study provides a computational framework for the development of phytochemical-based interventions that may complement existing vaccination strategies and support efforts to reduce antibiotic use in poultry, pending experimental validation. SUPPLEMENTARY INFORMATION: The online version contains supplementary material available at https://doi.org/10.1007/s40203-026-00727-z.
abstract_zh: 传染性支气管炎病毒（IBV）因其高传播性以及持续出现的抗原多样性变异株削弱疫苗效力，仍对家禽业构成重大威胁。病毒刺突蛋白介导宿主细胞附着和膜融合，是抗病毒干预的有利靶点。本研究采用基于结构的计算方法，识别靶向IBV刺突蛋白的植物化学抑制剂。将包含2,400种源自家禽安全植物来源的植物化学物质的精选库（PCLibVer2），使用Glide针对两个与受体结合域相关的结合口袋进行分层虚拟筛选。排名前三的先导植物化学物质通过三次独立的100 ns分子动力学模拟进行评估，随后进行基于轨迹的Prime MM-GBSA结合自由能计算和主成分分析。所有三种植物化学物质在模拟过程中均表现出良好的对接分数和稳定的蛋白质-配体相互作用。分子动力学分析显示，相对于脱辅基蛋白，其结构行为稳定、氢键相互作用持续，且构象采样减少。MM-GBSA分析预测所有复合物均具有有利的结合自由能，其中芦丁（Rutin）在两个结合口袋处均表现出最强的结合亲和力（-50.07 +/- 13.14 和 -55.14 +/- 20.22 kcal/mol）。主成分分析进一步表明，芦丁始终产生最紧凑的构象集合，表明蛋白质灵活性降低。计算机模拟ADMET分析确定了三种先导植物化学物质具有可比的药代动力学特征。总体而言，这些发现凸显了基于黄酮类化合物的植物化学物质作为IBV刺突介导病毒进入的天然抑制剂的潜力。本研究为开发基于植物化学物质的干预措施提供了计算框架，这些措施可能补充现有疫苗接种策略，并支持减少家禽抗生素使用的努力，有待实验验证。补充信息：在线版本包含补充材料，可在 https://doi.org/10.1007/s40203-026-00727-z 获取。
